document.abstract: A review of the film activities of various Federal agencies is presented, their educational significance suggested, and some general observations are made as to the Federal Government's interest in educational films. In conclusion, the vast potentialities of the educational film field are discussed and the part the Federal Government might play in its development pointed out.
